name: alexk413x
description: Claude Code plugins by Alex Koch. Each plugin works on its own and works better alongside the others.

plugins.name: ide-agent-tabs
plugins.description: Open Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and other agent sessions in IDE and terminal tabs, message between them, and delegate work to another agent.

plugins.name: codebase-kg
plugins.description: A committed, searchable code graph for each repo, so an agent finds code without mapping the codebase again every session. Links paired repos to track feature parity.

plugins.name: sentinel-swarm
plugins.description: An agent swarm that takes a PRD to built, tested, reviewed code: an Oracle, Managers, Leads and Coders, each its own session, held to a shared ledger and a scoring rubric.

plugins.name: the-index
plugins.description: A three-line band above the prompt that shows what your session costs, how close you are to a limit, and where your code stands.
